title: Small fillings of sphere slices at low-density points (Simon 8.2 (2)–(4), corrected)
statement: Assume (SL) and (MR), the exact frozen statements of cmc_slice_mass_bounds and cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, and (ISO), the exact conclusion of the sibling theorem cbr_isoperimetric_filling: for all P, m ∈ ℕ there is a real c ≥ 1 such that every integer multiplicity Z ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with compact support, ∂Z = 0 and M(Z) < ∞ is ∂Y for an integer multiplicity Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) with M(Y) ≤ c(2cM(Z))^{1/(m+1)}M(Z) and spt Y ⊆ thickening(3√P(2cM(Z))^{1/(m+1)}, spt Z); all three appear verbatim as hypotheses of the Lean statement. Then for all P, d ∈ ℕ there is η₀ > 0 with the following property. Let C ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) with ∂C = 0, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for compact K, ξ a μ-a.e. strongly measurable field of (d+1)-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. x and all α, with C(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ for every test form ω, and suppose C has the integer slice property ISP (verbatim as in the parent statement). If x₁ ∈ ℝ^P satisfies liminf_{r↓0} μ(B_r(x₁))/(ω_{d+1}r^{d+1}) < η₀ (ω_{d+1} = unitBallVolume (d+1), quotient in [0, ∞]), then for every δ > 0 there are ρ ∈ (0, δ) with μ(∂B_ρ(x₁)) = 0 and currents A, S ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{B_ρ(x₁)} ξ(ω) dμ for every test form ω, ∂S = ∂A, M(S) ≤ ½·μ(B_ρ(x₁)) and spt S ⊆ B̄_{(1+3√P)δ}(x₁).
